method: Built-in image_gen, UI-free physical scene artwork based on the user-approved page mockups.
preparation: WebP conversion and a separate right-side mobile crop. No controls or policy text are baked into these backgrounds.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: real website hero BACKGROUND PLATE with no interface. Use the supplied approved UI design as a reference for the physical 3D scene ONLY. Create ONE standalone very wide panoramic scene (3:1 aspect, 3072x1024), never a comparison board or split screen. This is the DARK THEME variant of the help page. A highly realistic physical support library: three upright paper guidebooks with simple legible covers Resume guide, AI writing, Export; an open loose-leaf folio with a violet bookmark lying on a polished grey stone desk; a few restrained books in an arched teal alcove and vertical fluting. All main objects clustered on the RIGHT HALF, with soft contact shadows and delicate desk-floor reflection.
Composition: camera front-on at shallow architectural perspective, wall-to-floor horizon visible, physical props on right between 58% and 92% of frame width. Keep the LEFT 48% a quiet empty wall area of nearly uniform deep ink charcoal where real HTML headline and buttons will later be overlaid. No title, UI, navigation, caption, buttons, watermark, inset frame or website text anywhere. Tiny realistic paper ink is decorative only. Keep all important objects away from top/bottom edges. Floor occupies bottom 23%, visibly reflective but not a mirror doubled object.
Materials and light: bevels, real paper thickness, tactile stone/leather/linen, soft directional studio light, physically plausible contact shadows, grounded proportions. Dark ink-navy/charcoal room, restrained teal or plum rim light according to the subject, off-white papers. Match the approved reference's art quality. No flat gradients, nebulous blobs or fake 2D object shadows. The paired theme uses the identical camera and objects.

Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: a UI-free physical website room background for the approved ProfileAI templates page in dark mode. Reference image is ONLY art direction. Create ONE standalone wide landscape architectural render, 2:1 aspect, about 2400x1200. Not a comparison, no panels, no border. Remove ALL website UI: no text, logo, header, controls, documents, price cards, paper sheets, floating object or foreground plinth. Real native website content will be overlaid later.
Studio in subtle lilac/aubergine: a large recessed circular arch centered in the back wall, graceful curved wall at the sides, deep vertical fluting along far edges, subtle lilac grazing light. It must match the approved gallery room's sculptural depth.
Physical floor is a MAJOR part of this image, bottom 42%, polished stone with fine perspective seams, soft authentic reflections of the architecture, visible wall-floor horizon at 58% image height. Camera shallow front-on architectural perspective, grounded material, realistic bevels and soft contact lighting. Empty level foreground space for three HTML product exhibits, clear center. Keep upper-left region very quiet for a large real headline. Deep ink room, atmospheric gentle directional blue/plum rim light, readable depth and visible floor, no blown out neon. No abstract blobs, fog hiding the floor, fake 2D gradient art, toy look or baked UI.
